function: Learned analog (constant-modulus) precoder for multiuser hybrid beamforming in near/far-field XL-MIMO, from perfect CSI or short uplink pilots; closed-form digital precoder (p. 2; p. 8).
system: Narrowband TDD MU-MISO; BS with 128-antenna ULA (UPA up to 512), 4 RF chains, K = 4 single-antenna users; 100 GHz; no RIS (p. 3; p. 10; p. 13).
method: Complex-valued network: grouped complex-convolution sensing layer, shared complex MLP, constant-modulus output head; unsupervised training (no labels) on the variant-MMSE loss (p. 6; p. 8).
data_channel: Custom simulated spherical-wave near/far-field multipath channel (Eq. 10), path gains CN(0,1), distances 5-80 m; 20,000 realizations per configuration; no public or measured data (p. 4; p. 10).
test_conditions: Separate dataset per configuration (K, L, r_max), 70/15/15 train/validation/test split; evaluation sweeps SNR, pilots, L, K, distance windows, UPA size; no unseen-condition test stated (p. 10).
baselines: Non-learned: TH-HMP (iterative SVD), LDMA codebook search, P-SOMP, P-SIGW, fully digital. Learned: SU-DNN [39] with and without CSI (p. 11; p. 12).
metrics: Sum rate (bps/Hz), sum-MSE objective in dB, per-user average sum rate (R/K); also runtime, parameters, FLOPs and training time in Tables II-III (p. 10; p. 11; p. 12).
complexity: DL-IMHB O((N+D_P)K^2M+...), 0.68 ms GPU / 2.89 ms CPU; 0.90 M parameters, 8.03 M FLOPs; DL-DMHB 0.92 M, 8.21 M (p. 11; p. 12).
q1_support: p. 10: "The uplink channel model follows (10)". Eq. (10) is a custom spherical-wave multipath model citing Saleh-Valenzuela [47] (p. 4); no 3GPP TR 38.901, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 10: "Independent datasets are constructed for different system" configurations (K, L, r_max), each split 70/15/15; no model trained under one condition and tested under another is reported (UPA runs need no architecture change, p. 13).
q3_support: p. 12: "DL-IMHB achieves 29.42 bps/Hz, improving over SU-DNN" (earlier learned method [39]); p. 12: "to match the rate achieved by DL-IMHB at N = 8" (non-learned TH-HMP [52]); both compared on sum rate.
q4_support: p. 10: "Table II summarizes the dominant-order inference complexities"; Table II (p. 11) gives O((N+D_P)K^2M+...) and 0.68 ms GPU; Table III (p. 12) gives 0.90 M parameters and 8.03 M FLOPs.
q5_support: p. 10: "Each dataset contains 20,000 independent multiuser channel" realizations generated by the authors; the paper gives no code or data link and no availability statement.
notes: Area 3: the learned part is the analog precoder (beams) of hybrid beamforming; direct mode adds a learned sensing layer but the main metric is sum rate. Tables I-III and Figs. 5-13 were read from page images (p. 10-14). Fig. 10 tests local distance windows inside the 5-80 m range, not a new scenario; reviewer to confirm q2.
